segments.title: 第 2 場：AI 系統 - 精選演講
segments.evidence: "Based on human observation. And starting from the beginning, it has tried more than 120 experiments... let me make a conclusion about some license pitchforks and limits we learned." 全篇首段內容談代理人構建生產系統的實驗與經驗教訓，與 Jun Yang 講題「經驗教訓、陷阱與極限」高度吻合，但無主持人介紹或講者自報姓名可直接佐證。

segments.title: 第 3 場：企業 AI - 精選演講
segments.evidence: "That wraps up our AI systems section. We are now on to Enterprise AI, where the first speaker would be Anno Reynas." 主持人明確宣布 AI Systems 場次結束、Enterprise AI 場次開始，並介紹下一位講者「Anno Reynas」，即 Eno Reyes（發音相近，agenda 首位講者）。

segments.title: 第 4 場：代理人評估與基準測試 - 主題演講
segments.evidence: "That now brings us to the session for agent evolution and benchmarks. We'll be starting with Debashi Raha, VP and fellow engineer at DigitalOcean on preferences, benchmarks, model routing." 主持人明確介紹新場次「代理人評估與基準測試」並點名首位講者 Debashi Raha，即 agenda 的 Debarshi Raha（拼寫相近）。

segments.title: 第 4 場：代理人評估與基準測試 - 精選演講
segments.evidence: "We now have Emily Zhu with Head of Enterprise AI at Scale AI on the exam before Enterprise deployment." 主持人介紹下一位講者「Emily Zhu」，對應 agenda 的 Yuan (Emily) Xue（Xue 發音近似被誤聽為 Zhu），講題「企業部署前的考驗」與 agenda 相符。

segments.title: 酒會與海報展示
segments.evidence: "And that concludes our sessions. We have a reception and posters to see downstairs. Thank you for your presence and your attention." 主持人宣布所有場次結束，邀請大家至樓下參加酒會與海報展示，對應 agenda 15:40 的「酒會與海報展示」。
